in_sanskrit.name: अश्वमेध
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: A ritual where a horse is set free to roam for a year, after which it is sacrificed.

in_hindi.name: अश्वमेध
in_hindi.long_meaning: एक रीति से घोड़े का बलि देना था, जिसमें एक घोड़े को एक साल तक आजाद रखा जाता था और फिर बलि किया जाता था।

in_tamil.name: அஷ்வமேதம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஒரு ஆண்டு நடைபெற்ற குதிரையை பலி செய்வது.

in_telugu.name: అశ్వమేధ
in_telugu.long_meaning: ఒక సాల తేదీ చేరుచుంది, ఫిర బలి కొన్ని.

in_marathi.name: Ashvamedh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashvamedh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashvamedh is a horse sacrifice ritual performed by ancient Indian kings to prove their supremacy.

in_bengali.name: Ashvamedh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Horse Sacrifice
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ashvamedh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Ashvamedh is a horse sacrifice ritual performed by ancient Indian kings to prove their supremacy.

vedic_reference.note: From the Yajurveda. A ritual where a horse is set free to roam for a year, after which it is sacrificed. The king who performs it is considered to have sovereignty over his neighbors.
